case_title: KURIA & ANR. v. STATE OF RAJASTHAN
aggravating_circumstances: Motive for murder, use of weapons, common intention to kill
neutral_facts: The accused and the victim were involved in a dispute over agricultural land. The victim was assaulted by multiple accused persons who arrived with weapons. The victim was dragged from his house and thrown near a hand pump. The body was found at the scene. Four eye-witnesses testified to the incident, and the post-mortem report confirmed the cause of death. Blood-stained clothing and weapons were recovered from the scene. The prosecution argued that the accused acted with common intention to kill the victim, and the evidence supported this claim.
